gen-gf-m-plus-rounded-1c-fs-literata: Soft, open-jawed curves define M PLUS Rounded 1c. Literata follows in a classic serif, its thin and thick strokes shifting just enough to keep a long read lively.
gen-gf-madimi-one-fs-literata: Madimi One curls its terminals in until they nearly touch, closing its letters up tight. Literata goes the other way, a serif with wide, unclosed curves and sturdy hairlines that suit sustained reading better than any heading.
gen-gf-maitree-fs-bespoke-sans: Maitree carries a medium swing from bold to faint in each stroke, which gives it a dignified, traditional bearing. And Bespoke Sans keeps curve ends well clear of the stem, so the big short headings stay with Maitree.
gen-gf-mako-fs-literata: Mako is plain through and through, with no quirks to distract from what it says. And Literata, a serif with restrained stem-to-connection contrast, adds the bookish warmth that Mako leaves out.
gen-gf-mallanna-fs-literata: Narrow, crisp, and open-faced. Mallanna packs its headings tightly, while Literata, a text serif with gentle stroke variation, gives the body room and a bookish ease.
gen-gf-manjari-fs-literata: Wire-thin lines, light as thread. Manjari holds one constant stroke, and Literata, a text serif cut like a barely tilted calligraphy nib, makes that sharp contrast the pair's best feature.
gen-gf-marcellus-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans leaves generous space between curve ends and stems, giving the text a sharp, refined finish. Marcellus is the one with dignity, pinching slightly where curves meet stems.
gen-gf-margarine-bitter: Margarine draws every line at a single unbroken weight, with a high x-height that makes its lowercase look big. Bitter, a slab-serif with a very large lowercase eye, gives that smoothness a grounded, dependable partner.
gen-gf-margarine-instrument-sans: Instrument Sans keeps its stroke weight constant, with c ends pointing apart like open pincers and a minimal cap-to-lowercase step. Margarine adds the distinctive swagger.
gen-gf-margarine-inter: Inter reads like a hollow reed cut open, with big counters in a tall lowercase and a smooth, tube-like line. But Margarine's high x-height and pen-plotter smoothness are what make the pairing memorable.
